historicalManifest.name: mainnet-1774000-1780000
historicalManifest.bounds: From 491 blocks before mainnet's 1.0 upgrade to 1,780,000, the end A99 names: U 1,774,491 (0x40e3…dd23, MNSV 22_000; its block carries the runtime, 1.1 MB) and F 1,774,492 (0x3802…1a0b, MNSV 1_000_000), the LG-2 pin; 91 blocks with Midnight transactions on both sides (ContractCall 86, ContractDeploy 2, unshielded transfers 3), one failed extrinsic (1,774,005, a FederatedAuthority governance call, not a Midnight transaction) and 31 system transactions. It starts mid-chain: decoding, events, outcomes and the pin need nothing else, but A99's state roots need the ledger state at 1,774,000 (A99's "from a backup taken before block 1,774,492").

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.mainnet.midnight.network --from 1774000 --to 1780000 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: decoding, events and outcomes across the 0.22 to 1.0 upgrade (A89, A91 on mainnet), the 1,774,492 pin (A94)
notes.needs: the ledger state at 1,774,000 for state roots (A99 mainnet half: a backup made by a sync from genesis, tasks 15.1, 18.x)

historicalManifest.name: mainnet-1780000-1790000

One backup at 1,774,000 serves both mainnet tapes in turn. It starts mid-chain: decoding, events and outcomes need nothing else, but A99's state roots need the ledger state at 1,780,000.

historicalManifest.name: stagenet-0-10000
historicalManifest.bounds: Stagenet from genesis, recorded from a third-party node (stagenet is a temporary network with no midnight.network node): block 0 and the first 10,000 blocks, all of runtime 2_000_000 (ledger v9 since genesis, so no v8 to v9 upgrade); 14 blocks carry Midnight transactions (unshielded transfers, heights 4,950 to 5,117) and 50 the node's own system transactions. From genesis, so it serves state roots on its own (A99-style, ledger v9); 853 of its midnight_ledgerStateRoot answers are a 971-byte root node rather than a 33-byte key.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.stagenet.shielded.tools --from 0 --to 10000 --live-seconds 60 (concurrency 8, 500 heights a connection)
notes.servesOnItsOwn: every criterion that replays from genesis on ledger v9 (no contract actions, no upgrade)
notes.needs: nothing; it cannot show the v8 to v9 upgrade (A96, A100, LG-9), which only the devnet tape holds

historicalManifest.name: devnet-v8-v9-0-235
historicalManifest.bounds: Our undeployed devnet (tools/devnet/devnet.sh), from genesis to height 235: the 2.1.0-rc.4 node on midnight-node 1.0.0's dev chain-spec, runtime 1_000_000 (ledger v8) to the governance upgrade enacted at U 102 (0x381f…99a8, MNSV 1_000_000), F 103 (0xba69…824d, MNSV 2_001_000, ledger v9) with the state conversion and the node's DUST reapply system transactions at F; our own traffic on each side. It holds every outcome kind the core stores: TxApplied (17), TxPartialSuccess (31 v8, 136 v9), ExtrinsicFailed (34 v8, 139 v9: governance proposals by non-members), SystemTransactionApplied (61, 103 three times, 166, 193, 230), and contract deploys, calls and maintenance on both ledgers. From genesis, so it serves state roots and the conversion (A100, LG-9) on its own.

notProduced.ExtrinsicFailed of a Midnight transactio: a double spend is dropped by the pool (validation dry-runs the guaranteed segment against the state), and two transfers over a lowered block_usage limit were applied in consecutive blocks (202, 203), not failed; a contract whose guaranteed transcript two calls make conflict at apply would produce it
notProduced.Midnight.ClaimRewards: no claimable rewards on the dev chain: claim-rewards is refused by the pool
notProduced.Midnight.PayoutMinted: declared by pallet-midnight at node-2.1.0-rc.4 but deposited nowhere in its code
notProduced.CNightObservation.SystemTransactionAppli: the dev chain's mock bridge repeats one registration; no cNight UTXO observation creates a system transaction
